title: Sankarea: Wagahai mo... Zombie de Aru...
justification: AniList 16694 (SPECIAL, 1 episode from 2012-11-30) is AniDB 8642's special S1 Wagahai mo... Zombie de Aru... (I, Too, Am... a Zombie...), aired 2012-11-30. AniList's PREQUEL relation names AniList 11499, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 8642, and the special's title matches AniList's romaji, English and native titles. The parent's row places S1 on TVDB 0x2 I, Too, Am... A Zombie... (2012-11-30) and, with the TMDB row, on TMDB 62742 S0E3 I am... a Zombie, too... (2012-11-30).
